title: A byte order mark inside a comment
notes: Comment text is `#` followed by non-break characters (production 75), and production 27 excludes the byte order mark, so a mark inside a comment is an error. It is not at the start of the stream, where a mark is allowed. The mark is the first character that cannot belong: line 1, column 4 (`#`, a space, `c`, then the mark).

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted a byte order mark in a comment.
